name: release-plan
description: Design a pre-deploy release and rollout strategy: pick the pattern (feature flag, canary, blue-green, or progressive delivery) by risk, then specify the exposure ramp, promotion metric and threshold, and rollback trigger. Designs the rollout, never executes it. Gated --godot-mobile and --godot-desktop modes plan a store or desktop ship. Use when a change nears deploy and needs a deliberate rollout. Do not use for post-deploy live-signal verification (use post-deploy-verifier) or a trivial fully reversible change.
